body: Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-10-28 06:25Z, my own slip on K1 w-a93dae1c29b7 round 10). A coordinator suggestion (Fable2 #3894) arrived while a /review-code pair was reading the frozen worktree, and I implemented it in that same worktree straight away. Both reviewers then covered a moving input, so I had to cancel them and start a new round. Rule: while a review pair runs on a freeze, do NOT edit the reviewed worktree. Either wait for the pair to finish, or first cancel the pair explicitly (termal_cancel_session), then edit, refreeze and respawn. A finding a reviewer submitted before the cancel still has to be addressed.
